title: Claim the listing
lead: "{name}" was added by EventDesk from public information. If it is your business, you can claim it for free: correct it, complete it and receive enquiries from planners.
source: The public source of the information

steps.title: How it works
steps.one: You start the claim from your EventDesk account.
steps.twoCode: We send a code to the email address the business publishes ({email}). You enter it here.
steps.twoModerator: The public source has no email address, so a moderator checks the claim against the public source.
steps.three: A second person on the EventDesk team approves. Then the listing belongs to your business.

alreadyClaimed.title: This listing has already been claimed
alreadyClaimed.body: If it is your business and you did not claim it, write to us through the report form.

signIn.title: Sign in to claim
signIn.body: You need an account with an email address. After signing in we bring you back to this page.

noEmail.title: Your account has no email address
noEmail.body: A business needs an owner with an email address. Add one to your account, then come back.

form.title: Start the claim
form.businessNameHint: This is how your business will appear in EventDesk. You can change it later.
form.ownBusiness: The listing will be attached to your business "{name}".
form.statementHint: For example "administrator" or "owner". It helps the moderator.
form.codeNote: The code goes only to the address the business publishes, never to an address written here.

code.title: Enter the code
code.body: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
code.label: The code from the email

status.verifiedBody: The claim is waiting for the EventDesk team's check and approval. We will tell you here; there is nothing more for you to do.
status.needsCheckTitle: The claim is waiting to be checked
status.needsCheckBody: A moderator compares it with the public source. If a document is needed, they contact you at your account's address.
status.inApprovalBody: A second person on the team has to approve. Until then the listing stays unclaimed.
status.approvedTitle: The listing belongs to your business
status.approvedBody: You can correct and complete it from the business area. Changes go through checking, as for any listing.
status.rejectedClaimed: The listing was claimed by someone else.

remove.title: Ask for removal or a correction
remove.lead: "{name}" was added from public information. If you represent the business, you can ask for the listing to be removed, object to it, or ask for a correction. We answer within 30 days at most.
remove.viaInvitation: You came here from the invitation sent to the business's published address. A removal request or an objection takes effect at once.
remove.messageHint: For a correction, write what is wrong and what is right.
remove.contactHint: We use it only for this request.
remove.doneNow: The listing has been withdrawn and the business will not be added from public sources again.
remove.doneLater: We have recorded the request. We will act on it within 30 days at most.
remove.claimInstead: If you would rather keep the listing and manage it yourself, you can claim it.
remove.privacy: We keep the request and how it was handled for 3 years, as evidence.

notAvailable.title: There is no unclaimed listing here
notAvailable.body: The listing has already been withdrawn or claimed. For a claimed listing, use the report form.

approval.describe_code: Claim for "{listing}" — code confirmed at the published address
approval.describe_moderator: Claim for "{listing}" — checked by a moderator against the public source

errors.codeInvalid: The code is not correct or has expired. Ask for a new one and try again.
errors.emailRequired: You need an account with an email address to claim a listing.
errors.tooManyCodes: We have already sent the maximum number of codes for this claim. Give it up and start again later.
errors.notReady: The claim is not in the right state for this action.
errors.checkRequired: Describe the check against the public source, at least 10 characters.

code.subject: The code for claiming the listing "{listing}"
code.body: Someone asked to claim the listing "{listing}" in the EventDesk directory. If it is you, enter this code on the claim page:
code.note: The code is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for the claim, ignore this message: without the code, nothing changes.

cta.title: Is this your business?
cta.body: Free. Once verified you can correct it, complete it and receive enquiries.
cta.remove: Ask for removal or a correction
